entity.name: Swizzle AI
entity.description: Indian-origin open-source systems & AI infrastructure organization led by Paramveer Singh (active upstream contributor to AIBrix, CNCF Volcano, Apache CloudStack, and CERN Scikit-HEP). Swizzle AI builds deterministic, bit-exact local LLM and edge robotics inference runtimes in pure Rust, CUDA, and Vulkan under the Apache-2.0 license.

projects.name: Swizzle Runtime (swizzle-rt)
projects.description: Exact, high-throughput Rust inference engine for GGUF and .ktc models with Swizzle XOR shared-memory CUDA GEMM tiles, cross-vendor Vulkan kernels, zero-copy Shortlist vocabulary screening, RAD-1 speculative decoding, Warm Start prefix caching, and Convoy continuous batching.

channels.description: Sponsor Swizzle AI development via GitHub Sponsors.
Support Swizzle AI via Linux Foundation LFX Crowdfunding.

plans.name: FOSS United Project Grant: Cross-Vendor Vulkan Parity, Receipts & Robotics VLA (4 Quarterly Milestones)
plans.description: Milestone-based 1-year plan: (Q1) Port TreeSum<K> reductions & Shortlist Cauchy-Schwarz vocabulary screening to Vulkan subgroup shaders (AMD/Intel/ARM GPUs); (Q2) Ship CBOR/JSON-LD cryptographic inference receipts (`swizzle-rt verify-receipt`) & multi-GPU parity CI; (Q3) Integrate 80 Hz deterministic VLA control loops in `swizzle-robotics` for student & edge robotics hardware; (Q4) Quarterly IndiaFOSS talks, forum updates & 'FOSS in Education' student workshops.

plans.name: Cross-Vendor GPU CI & Deterministic Verification Lab
plans.description: Dedicated bare-metal and cloud GPU test runners across NVIDIA (Turing through Blackwell), AMD RDNA, Intel Arc (Vulkan), and ARM64 SBCs to verify bit-exact inference receipts on every commit.

plans.name: Core Rust Inference Engine & Real-Time Robotics VLA Milestones
plans.description: Full-time engineering on Swizzle XOR CUDA/Vulkan kernels, Shortlist exact vocabulary bounds, RAD-1 ensemble speculative decoding, and sub-15ms robotics VLA control loops.
